args.subject: Action Required: Update Billing Address for Invoice Delivery
args.body:
Hi Contoso Team,

Customer C-7620 (Contoso Ltd) has requested an update to their billing contact address for invoice delivery. The current system record shows **billing@contoso.dev**; however, invoices are being sent to an outdated address.

**Next Steps:**
1. Confirm the new address for invoice delivery.
2. Reply to this email with the updated address.

Once received, I’ll update the system and process the pending **$80 late fee refund** (processing time: 3–5 business days).

**Note:** This aligns with audit policy RP-14; I’ll archive the old address.

Reply ASAP to resolve.

— [Your Name]
IT Operations Team
